summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K with an accompanying news release dated September 8, 2026, reporting progress on its summer 2026 exploration program at the Fenn-Gib project in Ontario. The release details geological mapping, 127 grab samples, and 23 condemnation drill holes totaling 6,184 meters for proposed infrastructure. Assay highlights show minor gold intersections. No transaction, shareholder action, or strategic event is announced. This is routine operational disclosure, not a special situation under event-driven classifications.
